title: From vacuum amplitudes to qubits
summary: High-energy colliders, exemplified by the CERN's Large Hadron Collider (LHC), constitute genuine quantum machines. In alignment with Richard Feynman's foundational vision for quantum computing, collider physics emerge therefore as a prime candidate for quantum simulations. Prospective applications include Quantum Machine Learning for collider data analysis, accelerated evaluation of complex multiloop Feynman diagrams, efficient jet clustering, enhanced parton shower simulations, and related computational challenges.
